post-tool-use.edit_file: pnpm exec prettier --write "$FILE" && pnpm exec eslint --fix "$FILE"
post-tool-use.write_to_file: pnpm exec prettier --write "$FILE" && pnpm exec eslint --fix "$FILE"

edit_file.description: Block edits to .env and lock files
edit_file.condition: if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.env(\..*)?$' && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.env\.example$'; then exit 1; fi; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(pnpm-lock\.yaml|package-lock\.json|yarn\.lock)$'; then exit 1; fi

write_to_file.description: Block writes to .env and lock files
write_to_file.condition: if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.env(\..*)?$' && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.env\.example$'; then exit 1; fi; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(pnpm-lock\.yaml|package-lock\.json|yarn\.lock)$'; then exit 1; fi
